name: Computers
overview: Scripture acknowledges human creativity and skill in crafting tools and structures, as seen in Cain building a city and Tubalcain instructing artisans in metalwork. However, it also highlights that God made man upright, yet mankind has pursued many inventions, reflecting both divine design and human initiative. The unity and ambition of humanity to accomplish great works are noted, but ultimately, true help and guidance come from the Lord, reminding believers to seek God's wisdom above human ingenuity.
